title: code_passenger workspace features v1
description: A workspace's features, declared once for every crate: each workspace feature's dependencies by crate, the workspace default, and each crate's own lines.

features.description: The one block of the document.

default.description: The workspace features on by default, in every crate that has them. Absent: each crate's default list stays as it is.

feature.description: A workspace feature on by default. Repeats: one value per line, in order.
One workspace feature. Repeats: one block per feature.

name.description: The feature's name, the same in every crate.

dep.description: `<crate>:<dependency>`: the crate gets the feature, and the dependency becomes optional behind it. Repeats: one value per line, in order.

crate.description: One crate's own lines. Repeats: one block per crate.

name.description: The crate, by its package name.

default.description: The crate's default list as Cargo spells it, replacing the derived one.

feature.description: One entry of the crate's default list. Repeats: one value per line, in order.

optional.description: A dependency made optional with no workspace feature (Cargo's implicit feature). Repeats: one value per line, in order.

feature.description: One feature's whole list in this crate, as Cargo spells it; it replaces the derived list, in this order. Repeats: one block per feature.

enable.description: One entry of the list: `dep:x`, `x/feat`, `x?/feat` or another feature. Repeats: one value per line, in order.
